action.action-desc: Mr. Kennedy introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry

form.official-title: To amend the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 to require consideration of the assets of a household for broad-based categorical eligibility for the supplemental nutrition assistance program.

section.header: Assets as income for categorical eligibility for the supplemental nutrition assistance program

subsection.text: Section 5(a) of the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2014(a)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in the fourth sentence, by striking Assistance and inserting the following:
in the third sentence, by striking Except and inserting the following:

subparagraph.text: by striking Notwithstanding and inserting the following:
by adding at the end the following:

clause.text: In this subparagraph, the term nonincome asset means available cash (including in a savings account or checking account), a stock, a savings bond, a mutual fund, a pension fund, and a real estate holding (other than a primary home).

A household described in subparagraph (A) shall not be eligible to participate in the supplemental nutrition assistance program if the total nonincome assets of the household are valued at not less than—

subclause.text: in the case of a household that includes an elderly or disabled member, $3,500.

paragraph.text: by striking (a) Participation and inserting the following:
Section 11(i)(2) of the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2020(i)(2)) is amended by striking the second sentence of section 5(a) and inserting section 5(a)(2).
Section 17(b)(1)(B)(iv)(III)(bb) of the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C 2026(b)(1)(B)(iv)(III)(bb)) is amended by striking the last sentence of section 5(a) and inserting section 5(a)(4).
